# The combination engine's dependencies — needed by this folder only, and only
# when Execute is pressed. The rest of the app is stdlib.
#
#     python3 -m pip install -r combination/requirements.txt
#
# Unpinned on purpose: these are the four the engine has always been run
# against, at whatever version the interpreter already has. If a version ever
# does matter, this is the file to say so in.
numpy
scipy
shapely
matplotlib
